shell_commands: find . -name "*.test.ts" -exec grep -l "it(" {} \; | head -5 | xargs grep -A1 "it(" | head -20
npm run build -- --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | grep -i "error\|warning" | head -20 || echo "Type check passed"
npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts --testNamePattern="receives collected response text and usage" 2>&1 | tail -30

git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: add spec links and changelog for aggregate usage reporting

Adds validation links to the spec file for all tests in the usage
aggregation work, and documents the breaking behavioral change in
CHANGELOG that afterModelResponse now receives summed usage across all
provider calls in a turn, not just the last one. Marks all facets as
complete in .lore/dod.md.

- Updates specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md with validation links
  for chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts and
  orchestratorHelpers.test.ts
- Documents the aggregate usage behavior change in CHANGELOG under
  ### Changed with migration notes for users of afterModelResponse hook
- Marks all four facets as [x] complete in .lore/dod.md
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD
